newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's BBA denies merger talks with BCN.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's BBA denies merger talks with BCN.

text.p: Brazilian private bank BBA Creditanstalt denied Tuesday a newspaper report saying the bank was about to merge or acquire the control of private bank BCN.
Jornal do Brasil daily said the deal, whose details were likely to be concluded this week, would be worth over $1.0 billion.
"The bank denies any merger with BCN," said a BBA spokeswoman.
Although both banks had repeatedly denied the reports, in recent months BCN and BBA have been the subject of speculation in the press that a merger would be announced any time soon.
Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein owns 49 percent of Brazil's Banco BBA Creditanstalt.
Earlier this year, BCN merged with Banco Itamarati.
